Maintenance State

Informs users that the application is temporarily unavailable for scheduled maintenance.

Maintenance Page

A full-page maintenance notification.

Scheduled Maintenance

We're currently performing scheduled maintenance to improve your experience. We'll be back shortly.

HTML
<div class="zak-maintenance-state">
    <div class="zak-maintenance-state-icon">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5">
            <path d="M14.7 6.3a1 1 0 000 1.4l1.6 1.6a1 1 0 001.4 0l3.77-3.77a6 6 0 01-7.94 7.94l-6.91 6.91a2.12 2.12 0 01-3-3l6.91-6.91a6 6 0 017.94-7.94l-3.76 3.76z"/>
        </svg>
    </div>
    <h1 class="zak-maintenance-state-title">Scheduled Maintenance</h1>
    <p class="zak-maintenance-state-text">We're currently performing scheduled maintenance.</p>
</div>

Maintenance Banner

A non-blocking banner for less critical maintenance notices.

Scheduled maintenance on Sep 15 from 2:00 AM to 4:00 AM UTC.
HTML
<div class="zak-maintenance-banner">
    <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
        <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/>
        <line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="12"/><line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12.01" y2="16"/>
    </svg>
    <span>Scheduled maintenance on Sep 15 from 2:00 AM to 4:00 AM UTC.</span>
    <button class="zak-maintenance-banner-close" onclick="this.parentElement.style.display='none'">&times;</button>
</div>

Maintenance with Estimated Time

Show an estimated time for when the service will be available again.

We'll be right back

We're upgrading our systems to serve you better. Expected to be back in approximately 45 minutes.

45 Minutes
:
00 Seconds
HTML
<div class="zak-maintenance-state">
    <div class="zak-maintenance-state-icon">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5">
            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/>
            <polyline points="12 6 12 12 16 14"/>
        </svg>
    </div>
    <h1 class="zak-maintenance-state-title">We'll be right back</h1>
    <p class="zak-maintenance-state-text">Expected to be back in approximately 45 minutes.</p>
    <div class="zak-maintenance-state-countdown">
        <div class="zak-maintenance-countdown-item">
            <span class="zak-maintenance-countdown-value">45</span>
            <span class="zak-maintenance-countdown-label">Minutes</span>
        </div>
        <div class="zak-maintenance-countdown-separator">:</div>
        <div class="zak-maintenance-countdown-item">
            <span class="zak-maintenance-countdown-value">00</span>
            <span class="zak-maintenance-countdown-label">Seconds</span>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

Maintenance with Contact Info

Provide support contact information during maintenance.

Under Maintenance

We're performing a major system upgrade. If you need immediate assistance, please contact our support team.

support@zakui.com
+1 (555) 123-4567
HTML
<div class="zak-maintenance-state">
    <div class="zak-maintenance-state-icon">...</div>
    <h1 class="zak-maintenance-state-title">Under Maintenance</h1>
    <p class="zak-maintenance-state-text">Please contact our support team for immediate assistance.</p>
    <div class="zak-maintenance-state-contact">
        <div class="zak-maintenance-contact-item">
            <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                <path d="M4 4h16c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2v12c0 1.1-.9 2-2 2H4c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V6c0-1.1.9-2 2-2z"/>
                <polyline points="22,6 12,13 2,6"/>
            </svg>
            <span>support@zakui.com</span>
        </div>
        <div class="zak-maintenance-contact-item">
            <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                <path d="M22 16.92v3a2 2 0 01-2.18 2 19.79 19.79 0 01-8.63-3.07 19.5 19.5 0 01-6-6 19.79 19.79 0 01-3.07-8.67A2 2 0 014.11 2h3a2 2 0 012 1.72"/>
            </svg>
            <span>+1 (555) 123-4567</span>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

Maintenance with Illustration

Decorative gradient illustration for the maintenance page.

System Maintenance

We're making improvements to serve you better. Follow us on social media for real-time updates.

HTML
<div class="zak-maintenance-state">
    <div class="zak-maintenance-state-illustration">
        <div style="width:140px;height:140px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--zak-warning-light),var(--zak-danger-light));display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="var(--zak-warning)" stroke-width="1.5">
                <path d="M14.7 6.3a1 1 0 000 1.4l1.6 1.6a1 1 0 001.4 0l3.77-3.77a6 6 0 01-7.94 7.94l-6.91 6.91a2.12 2.12 0 01-3-3l6.91-6.91a6 6 0 017.94-7.94l-3.76 3.76z"/>
            </svg>
        </div>
    </div>
    <h1 class="zak-maintenance-state-title">System Maintenance</h1>
    <p class="zak-maintenance-state-text">Follow us on social media for real-time updates.</p>
    <div class="zak-maintenance-state-actions">
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline">Follow Updates</button>
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-soft">Subscribe to Alerts</button>
    </div>
</div>

CSS Variables

HTML
:root {
    --zak-maintenance-banner-bg: var(--zak-warning);
    --zak-maintenance-banner-color: #000;
    --zak-maintenance-countdown-bg: var(--zak-surface-alt);
    --zak-maintenance-countdown-radius: 8px;
    --zak-maintenance-countdown-value-size: 2rem;
    --zak-maintenance-contact-gap: 1rem;
}
